CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
November 26, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

PRESENTATION OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION'S (LAEDC) MOST BUSINESS-FRIENDLY CITY AWARD - It is recommended Joe Torres from the LAEDC present the Most Business-Friendly City Award to the City Council.

7.

7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of November 12, 2019 and the minutes of the regular meeting of November 12, 2019.
7.1 Minutes of 11-12-19 Study Session Meeting
7.1 Minutes of 11-12-19 City Council Meeting
7.2

7.2 Warrant Register - City

7.3 Investment Report - October
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
ZONING ORDINANCE AMENDMENT NO. 50; DESIGN REVIEW NO. 1; TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 82311; AND THE ASSOCIATED MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF 39-CONDOMINUM DWELLING UNITS AT 12841 VALLEY VIEW AVENUE, IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law; affirm the findings of the Mitigated Negative Declaration; approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 50 and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 711 amending Table 6-1, "La Mirada Imperial Highway Specific Plan Permit Requirements," to allow non-restrictive for-sale housing within PA-1B of the IHSP; and adopt Resolution No. 19-39 approving Design Review No 1; Tentative Tract Map No. 82311; and the Associated Mitigated Negative Declaration to allow for the subdivision of the site located at 12841 Valley View Avenue into a condominium tract of 39 dwelling units with a network of private streets.
8.1 Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 50
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 710 AMENDING THE ZONING CODE, TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE AS FOLLOWS: ADDITION OF CHAPTER 21.56, SHORT-TERM RENTALS; AMENDMENTS TO CHAPTER 21.62, FENCES AND WALLS; REPEAL AND REPLACE CHAPTER 21.68, PARKING AND LOADING; AMENDMENT OF SECTION 21.78.030, SETBACK MEASUREMENTS; AND AMENDMENT OF SECTION 21.200.130, "L DEFINITIONS" - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 710 amending the Zoning Code, Title 21 of the La Mirada Municipal Code as follows: addition of Chapter 21.56, Short-term Rentals; amendments to Chapter 21.62, Fences and Walls; repeal and replace Chapter 21.68, Parking and Loading; amendment of Section 21.78.030, Setback Measurements; and amendment of Section 21.200.130, "L definitions."
9.1 Ordinance No. 710
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-40 AUTHORIZING THE SUBMITTAL OF AN APPLICATION FOR, AND RECEIPT OF, SENATE BILL (SB) 2, PLANNING GRANTS PROGRAM FUNDS – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-40 authorizing the submittal of an application for, and receipt of, Senate Bill (SB) 2, Planning Grants Program Funds.
